{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the row with highest sample_seq
data_dedup = data.loc[data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Step 2: Filter out rows where biomarker_baseline is -999
valid_data = data_dedup[data_dedup['biomarker_baseline'] != -999]

# Step 3: Compute the mean baseline biomarker value (already in ng/mL)
mean_baseline = valid_data['biomarker_baseline'].mean()

# Print the number of patients after deduplication
print(f'Number of patients after deduplication: {len(data_dedup)}')

# Print the number of valid baseline values (excluding -999)
print(f'Number of valid baseline values: {len(valid_data)}')

# Print the mean
print(f'Mean baseline biomarker value: {mean_baseline}')

# Print the number of rows with biomarker_baseline == -999
print(f'Number of rows with biomarker_baseline == -999: {(data["biomarker_baseline"] == -999).sum()}')"}
